cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(p0_link_selection LANGUAGES C)
# Isolated reproduction of pinned vcpkg e4563094 path ordering, lines 437-450.
# Library payloads are the controlled /OD+DEBUG and /O2+no-debug builds, not mocks.
set(vcpkg_paths "${P0_PREFIX}" "${P0_PREFIX}/debug")
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "^[Dd][Ee][Bb][Uu][Gg]$")
    list(REVERSE vcpkg_paths)
endif()
list(INSERT CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH 0 ${vcpkg_paths})
find_package(SQLite3 REQUIRED)
if(TARGET SQLite3::SQLite3)
    set(p0_target SQLite3::SQLite3)
else()
    set(p0_target SQLite::SQLite3)
endif()
get_target_property(p0_location ${p0_target} IMPORTED_LOCATION)
message(STATUS "P0_SELECTED_SQLITE=${p0_location}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/link-selection.json" "{\"cmake_build_type\":\"${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}\",\"generator\":\"${CMAKE_GENERATOR}\",\"imported_location\":\"${p0_location}\",\"compile_config\":\"Release\"}\n")
add_executable(p0_link_probe main.c)
target_link_libraries(p0_link_probe PRIVATE ${p0_target})
